title: Internal attention study
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 20 subjects performing a sustained attention task involving mental concentration on a target stimulus. Participants received automated verbal instructions guiding them through cycles of relaxation, preparation, and 15-second concentration periods, with the entire experiment conducted with eyes closed. The dataset includes 20 repetitions of the attention task per participant and is annotated using HED (Hierarchical Event Descriptors) version 8.0.0.
methods_description: EEG data were collected from 20 subjects during a guided attention task. Participants received four types of automated verbal instructions via speakerphone: wait, relax, get ready, and concentrate. Each trial cycle consisted of approximately 9 seconds of relaxation, 6 seconds of preparation, and 15 seconds of mental concentration on a target, repeated 20 times per subject with eyes closed throughout.
